# update the pages
I A 0 minecraft:writable_book*1{minecraft:writable_book_content:{pages:[{raw:"page one"},{raw:"page two"}]}}
I A 1 minecraft:writable_book*1
I A 2 minecraft:stick*1
I A 3 minecraft:writable_book*1
I A 12 minecraft:writable_book*1
I A 40 minecraft:writable_book*1

# sign the book
I A 0 minecraft:writable_book*1{minecraft:writable_book_content:{pages:[{raw:"page one"},{raw:"page two"}]}}
I A 1 minecraft:written_book*1{minecraft:written_book_content:{author:"A",pages:[{raw:"page &aone"},{raw:"page two"}],resolved:1b,title:{raw:"My Title"}}}
I A 2 minecraft:stick*1
I A 3 minecraft:writable_book*1
I A 12 minecraft:writable_book*1
I A 40 minecraft:writable_book*1
PKT A minecraft:container_set_slot 140009002501dc0a010039084d79205469746c65000141000208000a706167652026616f6e6500080008706167652074776f0001
# a stick is no book

I A 2 minecraft:stick*1
I A 3 minecraft:writable_book*1
I A 12 minecraft:writable_book*1
I A 40 minecraft:writable_book*1
# a slot outside the hotbar and the offhand is ignored, also with a title
I A 0 minecraft:writable_book*1{minecraft:writable_book_content:{pages:[{raw:"page one"},{raw:"page two"}]}}
I A 1 minecraft:written_book*1{minecraft:written_book_content:{author:"A",pages:[{raw:"page &aone"},{raw:"page two"}],resolved:1b,title:{raw:"My Title"}}}
I A 2 minecraft:stick*1
I A 3 minecraft:writable_book*1
I A 12 minecraft:writable_book*1
I A 40 minecraft:writable_book*1
# the offhand, no pages, and a signed book is no writable book any more
I A 0 minecraft:writable_book*1{minecraft:writable_book_content:{pages:[{raw:"page one"},{raw:"page two"}]}}
I A 1 minecraft:written_book*1{minecraft:written_book_content:{author:"A",pages:[{raw:"page &aone"},{raw:"page two"}],resolved:1b,title:{raw:"My Title"}}}
I A 2 minecraft:stick*1
I A 3 minecraft:writable_book*1
I A 12 minecraft:writable_book*1
I A 40 minecraft:written_book*1{minecraft:written_book_content:{author:"A",pages:[{raw:"left"}],resolved:1b,title:{raw:"Off"}}}
PKT A minecraft:container_set_slot 14000a002d01dc0a010039034f666600014100010800046c6566740001
